summary: Frontend-only regression test (Playwright, localhost:8000) of the Alpine.js fix on /settings?tab=ai-profile. The reported user bug ('gak bisa tambah skill/sertifikat/bahasa') is now FIXED. window.Alpine, window.Livewire and window.lucide are all defined on /settings, no ReferenceError 'Alpine is not defined', all 3 add buttons increment rows (0->1->2), delete (trash) removes rows, lucide trash-2 SVG icons render, full form submit returns to /settings?tab=ai-profile with flash 'Profil kandidat berhasil disimpan.', and all data (nama, 2 skills TCP/IP=BASIC + VLAN=INTERMEDIATE, 1 sertifikasi HCIA/Huawei/2024, 1 bahasa English/INTERMEDIATE) persists after reload. /apply Livewire regression OK (5 Livewire components hydrated, badge shows 'Profil kandidat: 79% lengkap'). Alpine.data('glintsSearchLocation') is confirmed registered globally on both /apply and /settings via DOM injection probe (returns keys query/results/searching/search/selectLocation). php artisan test AiProfileTest: 7/7 passed.

integration_issues.issue: Toggle could NOT be exercised: input[data-testid='auto-answer-toggle'] is rendered with the `disabled` attribute because the OpenRouter/AI API key is not configured for the test user (badge shows 'API key belum diatur → Buka Settings'). This appears to be intended business logic, not a regression, but the on/off flow requested in the review is therefore UNVERIFIED. Seed an AI provider api_key for test-ai-profile@example.com if this path must be covered.

issues: Provider select renders with ZERO options (no connected accounts for the test user) and no placeholder/empty-state text — appears as a blank narrow dropdown next to 'Simpan Perubahan'. Add a disabled placeholder option or an empty state ('Belum ada akun provider terhubung').

Because no provider is selected, the livewire/provider-configuration partial (which contains x-data="glintsSearchLocation()") is never rendered on this page — registration was verified via injection probe instead.

'Tanggal Lahir' uses the browser-native <input type="date"> picker (mm/dd/yyyy, US format) inconsistent with the Indonesian UI copy; consider a custom/localized date component or at least lang/format hint.
Skills/Sertifikasi/Bahasa delete buttons have no aria-label or data-testid; test had to locate them via row-scoped 'button'. Recommend data-testid='ai-profile-remove-skill' etc.

action_items: No blocking action: the original bug is fixed and all requested add/delete/save/persist flows pass.
Optional: add data-testid + aria-label to the row delete (trash) buttons for skills/sertifikasi/bahasa.
Optional: add placeholder/empty-state to the Konfigurasi Provider select on /apply.
Optional: seed an AI provider API key for the test user so the 'AI Powered Auto Answer' toggle can be regression-tested.
critical_code_review_comments: resources/js/app.js registers Alpine.data inside the 'alpine:init' listener while @vite emits app.js as type=module (deferred) and @livewireScripts is injected at end of <body>. This currently works (verified at runtime) because Livewire fires alpine:init after module evaluation, but the ordering is fragile — safer to import Alpine data via Livewire's documented 'livewire:init'/Alpine plugin hook or move the registration into a script loaded before livewireScripts.

@livewireScripts is now loaded on EVERY page using layouts/app.blade.php, adding Livewire+Alpine payload to pages with no Livewire component. Acceptable trade-off, but consider @alpineScripts/standalone Alpine if bundle size matters.

Blade view resources/views/settings/tabs/ai-profile.blade.php contains a large inline x-data object literal (~20 lines) plus a very long form; extracting the Alpine state into resources/js/alpine/ai-profile.js would improve maintainability and testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable scenarios (8/9 verified, 1 blocked by missing AI API key)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Alpine bug is CLOSED. Verify via page.evaluate('() => !!window.Alpine') on /settings — returns true. Add/delete buttons for skill/sertifikasi/bahasa all work; rows use data-testid ai-profile-skill-row / -sertifikasi-row / -bahasa-row, delete buttons have no testid (use row-scoped 'button'). Remaining untested: /apply auto-answer toggle (disabled, needs AI API key seeded), provider-configuration glints location search UI (needs a connected provider account).
rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure: layouts/app.blade.php lacked @livewireScripts, so on pages without a Livewire component Alpine was never injected and resources/js/app.js threw 'Alpine is not defined' when calling Alpine.data at module top level, aborting lucide icon init too. Fix (adding @livewireStyles/@livewireScripts to the layout + deferring Alpine.data registration into the alpine:init listener + exposing window.lucide) is verified working at runtime.
